mapper.select: SELECT id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) display_id,alert_instance_id alert_id,incident_id,rule_id,rule_code,severity,owner_team,target_order,channel_sequence channel_order,escalation_status status FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND alert_instance_id=#{alert} AND escalation_status='RUNNING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) display_id,alert_instance_id alert_id,incident_id,rule_id,rule_code,severity,owner_team,target_order,channel_sequence channel_order,escalation_status status FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id)=#{id}

SELECT id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) display_id,alert_instance_id alert_id,incident_id,rule_id,rule_code,severity,owner_team,target_order,channel_sequence channel_order,escalation_status status FROM t_alert_notification WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_TARGET' AND escalation_chain_id=#{chain}

SELECT id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) display_id,target_type type,target_user_id user_id,notify_recipients channels_json,target_order `order` FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_TARGET' AND escalation_chain_id=#{chain} AND target_order=#{order} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) display_id,target_type type,target_user_id user_id,notify_recipients channels_json,target_order `order` FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_TARGET' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id)=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_notification SET severity=#{severity} WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND alert_instance_id=#{alert} AND escalation_status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='NOTIFICATION' AND alert_instance_id=#{alert} AND notify_channel=#{channel} AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(notify_content,'$.eventType')),event_type,'')='ALERT_ESCALATION'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT notify_channel) FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='NOTIFICATION' AND alert_instance_id=#{alert} AND notify_channel IN #{channel} AND COALESCE(event_type,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(notify_content,'$.eventType')),'')='ALERT_FIRED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='NOTIFICATION' AND alert_instance_id=#{alert} AND notify_channel=#{channel} AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(notify_content,'$.eventType')),event_type,'')='ALERT_FIRED'
SELECT notify_content FROM t_alert_notification WHERE escalation_chain_id=#{chain} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_notification SET escalation_status='IN_PROGRESS' WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_TARGET' AND escalation_status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET ack_deadline=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND escalation_status='RUNNING' AND target_order=#{target} AND channel_sequence=#{channel}
mapper.select: SELECT id,escalation_chain_id chain_id,escalation_target_id target_id,target_user_id,channel_sequence channel_order FROM t_alert_notification WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='NOTIFICATION'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_notification SET channel_sequence=channel_sequence+1,ack_deadline=NULL,last_error_summary=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND escalation_status='RUNNING' AND target_order=#{target} AND channel_sequence=#{channel}

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET escalation_status='ACKNOWLEDGED',target_user_id=#{user},acknowledged_at=NOW(3),ack_deadline=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND escalation_status='RUNNING'
UPDATE t_alert_notification SET escalation_status='ACKNOWLEDGED' WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_TARGET' AND escalation_status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS','FAILED')
UPDATE t_alert_notification SET acknowledged_at=NOW(3),acknowledgement_type=#{type} WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='NOTIFICATION' AND escalation_chain_id IS NOT NULL

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET escalation_status='ACKNOWLEDGED',target_user_id=#{actor},acknowledged_at=NOW(3),ack_deadline=NULL WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND alert_instance_id=#{alert} AND escalation_status='RUNNING'
UPDATE t_alert_notification SET escalation_status='CANCELLED',ack_deadline=NULL WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND alert_instance_id=#{alert} AND escalation_status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) display_id,target_order,channel_sequence channel_order FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND escalation_status='RUNNING' AND ack_deadline<=NOW(3) ORDER BY ack_deadline,id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_notification SET channel_sequence=channel_sequence+1,ack_deadline=NULL,last_error_summary=#{reason} WHERE id=#{row.id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND escalation_status='RUNNING' AND target_order=#{row.targetOrder} AND channel_sequence=#{row.channelOrder} AND ack_deadline IS NOT NULL AND ack_deadline<=NOW(3)

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET escalation_status='FAILED' WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_TARGET' AND escalation_chain_id=#{chain} AND target_order=#{order} AND escalation_status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET target_order=target_order+1,channel_sequence=1,last_error_summary=#{reason} WHERE id=#{row.id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND escalation_status='RUNNING' AND target_order=#{row.targetOrder} AND channel_sequence=#{row.channelOrder}

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET escalation_status='EXHAUSTED',ack_deadline=NULL,last_error_summary=#{reason},last_provider_code=#{code},last_error_type='P0' WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND escalation_status='RUNNING'
